translation: The balance running at birth is computed from the elapsed portion of the Moon's stay in the Janma Nakshatra and subtracted from the full dasha span of the ruling planet.
context_before: The text has already established the planetary order and years of Vimshottari.
context_after: The edition then gives a worked example using Mrigasira and explains a longitude-based simplification used by later researchers.
notes: This record captures current research evidence only and does not authorize changing the existing VEDA birth-balance implementation.
